what is java (Please provide a concise, short summary response.)

**Java** is a high-level, object-oriented programming language designed to be platform-independent. Utilizing the "Write Once, Run Anywhere" (WORA) principle, Java code can run on any device equipped with a Java Virtual Machine (JVM). It is widely used for developing enterprise software, web applications, and mobile apps (especially for Android).
